answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small deposit that is slashed when its work is graded as junk, like a pigment that stains every clone an attacker tries to mint. An identity that has written a sonnet of verifiable, attested work over time earns reputation weight that a fresh tide of copy accounts cannot fake overnight. Clones start with zero history and pay the same deposit each, so flooding the network gets expensive while honest agents keep their stake and earn more.
